fieldValues.thinking_reached: Reports: the work-flow audit of the week to 2026-10-23 (254 merged PRs, 176 of them process and memory, none finished without the owner's merge); the decision-taxonomy exercise of 2026-10-22; the archaeology of 2026-10-08; the retrospective on shipping RFC-051 and RFC-052 (45 PRs over 2 days 21 hours). Rulings: 949ae72d (merge rights), f58db200 (one work-status set), da1a4063 (tasks live as issues), 071eadb2 (no core changes until the process is refined). Findings: 716c8ce1, 3807ea6d, 157dc2a3. Today: SP-109 and clerk#224 (issue templates), clerk#223 (bugs), and the owner's ruling that bugs need no problem.
